title.narrative: Frontier Tech Hub: Real-Time Price and Inflation Tracker for Moldovan Audiences

description.narrative: A mini-project alongside the Frontier Technologies Programme to deliver an AI-powered interactive widget embedded on NewsMaker.md, supported by regular explanatory content via newsletters and social platforms. The tool will automatically collect and process verified data from trusted public institutions, including the National Bureau of Statistics of Moldova, the National Bank of Moldova, and the National Energy Regulatory Agency. Where technically feasible, the system may also integrate anonymised price data from online marketplaces and supermarkets to enrich the analysis. DT Global will manage the contracting process for this pilot as well as providing coaching support, ensuring that all agreements are in place with Newsmaker and external consultants involved, and compliance is maintained throughout the project lifecycle.
